launcher_review.scope: Narrow static delta against the previously reviewed music-load launcher; no launcher execution or host queries by these reviewing agents.
checks: Only accepted duration/control pairs are600/300 and3600/300; forwarded flag is --delivery-mode playback-paced.
Pending signed HEAD/soak/worker pins reject before host queries or output creation; final arming is a separate root action.
Existing frozen runtime/model/UI/audio/shared/sampler/helpers and four manifest-ordered prepared WAV identities remain checked before readiness.
Unchanged bounded normal-readiness observation precedes reviewed fresh<=70C/same recovered guard/balanced/no-holds/AC/open-lid admission.
Existing software33ms environment,45-second abort-on-bad AC/lid observation, owned KWin/observer sessions and bounded cleanup are preserved.

audit_review.scope: Read-only static review of the saved-file audit, including the final terminal-coverage delta; AST parsing passed, but the audit was not executed during these reviews.
checks: Retains baseline/corpus, raw generation/source/control/currentness/parity, audio/UI and owned lifecycle closure checks;600s requires1 control,3600s requires11, both require all four sources complete and repeat.
Raw demand/chunk/hop/delivery joins preserve ordinary deadlines by actual frames/rate across lateness and source rotation; only initial delivery and explicit seek recovery anchor epochs.
Explicit interruption must refer to the current held generation before its next due time and match its cancellation control.
Ready/wake/delivery lateness, queue residence/count distributions and completed-demand starvation interval union are reduced separately.
A final obligation due before planned stop cannot disappear. An unissued terminal record preserves null wake/queue/wait; unadmitted next-source identity stays distinct from observed loaded state.
Functional audit validity remains separate from latency/deadline outcomes; the producer full-hour qualification flag is independently checked.

limits: Static review and syntax verification only; this record reports no benchmark, test, host-readiness, thermal, audio or qualification outcome.
Pending configuration at original launcher review was intentional. This record does not assert that the later armed expected-pins.json has the same bytes.
Readiness and monitored values are sampled observations; no continuous-state, direct guard-latch, physical stem playback or hardware-preemption guarantee follows.

audit_revision.cause: The initial replay bound demand identity to consumed telemetry log order. A load control is issued before the next source demand, but its queued telemetry is intentionally polled and logged after that demand.
audit_revision.change: Bind the demand to the latest raw control issue timestamp at or before its recorded consumer wake, require load/seek and the same generation/source, and derive expected frame from already delivered current-generation chunks. Fixed deadlines, no-early-poll and all other checks are retained.

independent_review.scope: Static delta review only; no workload or measurement edits.

audit_revision.measurement_preservation: No source, runtime, input, result, event, trace, audio or UI bytes were modified; only the ignored replay helper and its derived audit report changed.
audit_revision.initial_record_scope: The original static review record and initial helper/report bytes are preserved explicitly. Original review facts above remain historical; saved_audit now identifies the corrected helper.
